snippet.title: Vanran - Official Release Window Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Vanran is a dark fantasy action RPG where a human slave in the Demon Realm wields a sealed blade and rises in rebellion. Defeat your enemies, claim their powers, grow stronger, and escape. Seek salvation—or choose vengeance. Get a look at gameplay, boss fights, and more from Vanran in this new trailer. Vanran will be available on Xbox Series X/S and PC in 2027.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
